input: The QNC keyboard catalog, the scopes of a board and whether the catalog action toggle_cheatsheet was pressed this frame.
output: A window listing every key of the active preset for those scopes with its catalog label. Open/closed is window state of the UI context only.
specification: User request 2026-10-01: F1 (catalog toggle_cheatsheet) shows the keys so nobody has to remember them. Called from qnc-key-intents so every board that reads keys has it.
